CVE-2026-115456.reason: Unfixed libstdc++ std::from_chars out-of-bounds read with non-NUL-terminated buffers can cause invalid float parsing or denial of service. The authenticated single-trust-domain service accepts bounded media and typed options, not C++ pointers, compiler input or arbitrary native code. Exact distro source/library identity, non-root execution, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, absent setid programs, shells and compiler headers are required. These controls limit exposure and privilege impact; they do not prove native decoder paths unreachable or repair parsing. Residual process availability and parsing risk remains disclosed. Wheel-bundled libraries, optional realtime operator images and alternate callers require separate assessment.
